unlisted_practices: Replacing one of two radiologist readers with AI as an independent reader in mammography double reading

links.outcome: Screen-detected breast cancer compared with standard-of-care double reading
links.effect: One radiologist plus AI was non-inferior to two radiologists: 261 [0·5%] vs 250 [0·4%] detected cases; relative proportion 1·04 [95% CI 1·00-1·09].
links.quote: 269 (0·5%) women were diagnosed with screen-detected breast cancer based on an initial positive read: double reading by one radiologist plus AI was non-inferior for cancer detection compared with double reading by two radiologists (261 [0·5%] vs 250 [0·4%] detected cases; relative proportion 1·04 [95% CI 1·00-1·09]).

links.outcome: Prospective cancer detection with AI-inclusive reading versus standard care
links.effect: Triple reading by two radiologists plus AI was non-inferior to two radiologists: 269 [0·5%] vs 250 [0·4%] detected cases; relative proportion 1·08 [1·04-1·11].
links.quote: Single reading by AI (246 [0·4%] vs 250 [0·4%] detected cases; relative proportion 0·98 [0·93-1·04]) and triple reading by two radiologists plus AI (269 [0·5%] vs 250 [0·4%] detected cases; relative proportion 1·08 [1·04-1·11]) were also non-inferior to double reading by two radiologists.
